strings.HelpBody:
Shortcuts: F5 refresh list, Esc cancel operation, Ctrl+L clear logs, Ctrl+H hide to tray.

RAR uses RAR, ZIP and 7z use 7-Zip; the recovery record only applies to RAR. Enter one attachment folder per line, or use the Browse button to select multiple folders.

System notifications, tray and shutdown are provided by the current operating system; Linux needs notify-send, and shutdown may require administrator rights.

Closing the window really exits the app; to keep it running in the background, use "Hide to Tray" and then show/hide or exit from the tray menu.
